lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like pattern with approximately 4-5 spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular spots, creating a structured lattice on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge with a sharp luminance gradient (light upper edge, dark lower shadow) extends from the dorsal margin of the gill slits posteriorly along the mid-flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 4 distinct high-intensity white spots are visible on the surface of the first dorsal fin, clustered toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark vertical linear mark is present on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot morphology is observed from small, high-density clusters on the head to larger, grid-aligned circular nodes on the body.
